en: [language] Target = floating wood. Begin close-range interaction.
zh: [language] 目标=水面木头；启动近距离交互。

en: [vision] Wood surfaces. Update its relative position.
zh: [vision] 木头露出水面；更新相对位置。

en: [action] Press down with a forepaw. Try to secure the floating target.
zh: [action] 前爪下压；尝试固定漂浮目标。

en: [feedback] Splash obscures the target. Stop using stale coordinates.
zh: [feedback] 水花遮挡目标；暂停使用旧坐标。

en: [policy] Turn to adjust the contact angle. Continue grasping.
zh: [policy] 转身调整接触角度；继续抓取。

en: [action] Lower the head to contact the wood again. Maintain body support.
zh: [action] 再次低头接触木头；保持身体支撑。

en: [policy] Target moves in front. Switch to close-range control.
zh: [policy] 目标转至身前；改用近身控制。

en: [action] Nudge the wood again with a forepaw. Correct the contact point.
zh: [action] 前爪再次拨动木头；修正接触位置。

en: [feedback] Wood is still floating. Grasping task auto-refilled.
zh: [feedback] 木头仍在漂；抓取任务自动续杯。
